summary: Create account assessments, stakeholder maps, and practical growth plans. Explore the five-day account planning training and enquire today.
lede: Account planning and account mapping help sales and account professionals turn customer knowledge and CRM records into a coordinated growth plan. They can map buying committees and relationship coverage, assess whitespace, and prioritize opportunities. The course also covers assigning engagement actions, owners, and review measures.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who coordinate account growth, customer relationships, and sales activity. It suits people who need to convert account information into a shared map of decision-makers, priorities, opportunities, and follow-up actions.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of sales, business development, or customer account responsibilities is recommended. Bring a laptop with Excel or a compatible spreadsheet application; no coding or specialist software installation is required. Use anonymized account information if you choose to work with your own customer records. CRM concepts are discussed, but you do not need a CRM login.
